checks.exercise: Seated left dumbbell concentration curl; front/side and both final encoded sheets reviewed.
checks.equipment: Single hex dumbbell and flat bench; dumbbell-only mapping.
checks.setup: Seated with spread legs and forward torso lean. Working elbow at inner knee; opposite hand rests on other knee.
checks.hands: Supinated working grip stays on dumbbell. Free hand stable throughout.
checks.feet: Both feet stay planted; seated root and torso stay fixed.
checks.movement: Curl toward shoulder and controlled lowering, supported elbow fixed and one-second top pause. Opposite side repeats the demonstrated cycle.

checks.exercise: Standing rope face pull; front/side and both encoded sheets reviewed.
checks.equipment: Eye-height pulley with two-ended rope and synchronized weight stack; cable-only mapping.
checks.setup: Stable upright stance facing tower; head and torso stay still.
checks.hands: Grips follow handles as hands separate outside face; rope segments each remain 4.5 model units.
checks.feet: Feet fixed during pull and return.
checks.movement: Elbows move outward/back while hands reach outside face. Controlled return and seamless cycle; updated app tip matches hand separation.

checks.exercise: Cable upright row newly rendered to replace old cutout-review candidate; front/side and both encoded sheets inspected.
checks.equipment: Low cable pulley, straight rigid-width bar and moving stack; cable-only mapping.
checks.setup: Upright stance with bar in front of thighs, torso stable.
checks.hands: Pronated grips remain on bar; grip separation is constant.
checks.movement: Elbows lead outward while bar rises toward lower chest; elbows stay below shoulders. Controlled return; cable and stack stay synchronized.

limitations: Simplified procedural anatomy and clothing; seated waistband and shoulder deformation remain stylized. Dark theme dumbbell and rope contrast lower than light theme. No full mesh collision or biomechanics certification. Physical Android device and production pending.
